clips.text: Mamma mia! You with the keyboard. Focus, idiota!
This gun shoots everywhere except where I aim. Che schifo!
Again? This game is broken. Rocco cannot possibly be the problem.
Come here, stronzo. I have a present.
Mamma mia, you aim like a broken toaster!
All that noise, and you still miss!
My ears! Basta with the noise!
Oof! That hit like a truck!
That shockwave went straight through me!
Acid and poison! Get it off!
Steam! I can't see a damn thing!
Vieni qui! Say that to my face, stronzo!
I'll kill you, pezzo di merda!
Keep talking. I'll knock those teeth out!
Bon. Let's try to be professional.
Respawned. Magnifique. Perhaps you could aim this time, mon ami.
This weapon is an insult to engineering. I demand a refund!
Clearly a bug. A flawless man, a badly coded game.
Your aim is an insult to geometry, mon ami.
All this equipment, and absolutely no talent.
The ice is shattering around me!
Viens ici! Say that to my face, connard!
I'll kill you, mon cher. Slowly.
Shut your mouth and come fight me!
Vamos! Keep up if you can!
Otra vez? Hey, genius at the keyboard. Try staying alive!
This gun is basura! I want the one the enemy has!
The game cheated, amigo. Obviously. My talent is not up for debate.
Vamos, cabron. Hit me if you can!
Stop shooting the furniture! I'm over here!
That was your best shot? Que pena!
The ice is breaking! I'm shattering!
That ringing punch went through me!
Marcado! They know where I am!
Ven aqui! Say that to my face, cabron!
Te voy a matar! You're dead, amigo!
Keep talking. I'll shut that mouth for you!
Opyat! You at keyboard. Concentrate, durak!
Gun is defective. Bullets refuse to cooperate. Very suspicious.
Another death. Engine problem. I am submitting complaint. To nobody.
Idi syuda. Even you can hit at this distance.
So much ammunition. So little talent.
Come closer, pridurok. I am getting bored.
Kholodno. Too cold, even for me.
Kislota. It is eating the armor.
Ice shattering. I am breaking with it.
Resonance. Felt that in my bones.
Idi syuda! Say that to my face.
Big mouth. Come closer. We fix that.
Schon wieder! You at the keyboard. Focus, du Idiot!
This rifle is defective. I demand German quality control!
The engine has made an error. Naturally, I am operating perfectly.
Come here, Dummkopf. Show me your aim.
So much ammunition. So little talent.
Komm her! Say that to my face!
Enough talking. Come and fight me!
Oof! That hit like a truck!
That shockwave went straight through me!
Pali? You with the keyboard! Wake up, re!
This gun is useless! Even my grandmother could build a better one!
Terrible game. Obviously the developers are afraid of my talent.
Come here, malaka. I have a surprise.
My grandmother shoots better than you!
All that noise, and you still miss, file!
Ela edo! Say that to my face!
Keep talking. I'll knock those teeth out!
Oof! That hit like a truck!
That shockwave went straight through me!
